Brand/model text appears on the front panel area: 'PSR-550' is visible on the left side of the control panel.
There is a built-in display/screen on the right side of the control panel.
The keyboard has visible wear/scuffs on the front panel area (some marks around the control/display region).
A small label/tag near the lower left front reads 'PSR-550'.
No power-on screen test is shown in the photo.
No close-up of all buttons/keys, and no adapter/cable is clearly shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the keyboard powered on or any functional test (no screen on, no sound/keys/buttons verification).
Photo 0 shows the keyboard but does not demonstrate key presses or button operation.
Photo 0 does not clearly show an adapter/cable.
No UK purchase proof (receipt, label, or documentation) is visible in photo 0.
No audio test or key-by-key test is shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Keyboard may have non-working keys/buttons or intermittent faults (seller claims 'working perfectly' but no test shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a video: power on + screen working, then demonstrate at least one full octave of keys and several buttons (including volume and a few function buttons) with audible sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/possible faults (worst case: treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Display/backlight or controls may be damaged or glitchy (visible wear/scuffs on the front panel area).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up video of the screen turning on and staying stable while navigating menus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as screen/control condition uncertain (worst case: assume display may be problematic).

risks.risk: Adapter may not be included or may be the wrong spec, preventing proper testing.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact adapter model/spec label and the plug end, plus confirmation it matches the keyboard input.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst case: buyer may need to source one).

risks.risk: Audio crackle/noise could exist at certain notes or when using speakers/headphones (seller claims no crackle but no audio evidence).
risks.proof: Ask for a short audio clip: play several notes across low/mid/high range and show headphone output if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible speaker/audio noise (worst case: assume crackle may be present).

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the screen clearly and that it responds to button/menu presses.
Audio test video: play low, middle, and high keys (at least one octave each) and show volume changes.
Video/audio check for crackle: play sustained notes and chords, then stop/start to show consistency.
Clear photo of the adapter/cable included (show the label/spec and the connector).
Close-up photos of any scuffed/damaged areas on the control panel and speaker grille.
response.reason: The model 'PSR-550' is readable from the photo, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' and 'no dead key/no crackle' claims are not verifiable remotely because there is no power-on or audio/key/button test shown, and adapter inclusion is not visible.
